title: The display is recorded in analytics after loading and on each switch
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. On the Work Orders QA build with Google Analytics enabled for the org and a way to observe the events fired (browser devtools Network tab, or engineering/dev support).
  4. Ensure the location has eligible lead technicians and work orders so the displays and fields can be exercised.
  5. Ability to observe analytics events (analytics debug view or engineering/dev support).
custom_steps:
1. Load the Work Orders page and confirm one display-view event after it finishes loading.
  2. Switch display option and switch filter view; confirm one event each.
  3. Trigger an ordinary row refresh; confirm no new display-view event.
  4. Confirm display, field, and density usage is being measured as Story 12 specifies (Story 5 defers measurement to Story 12).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A display-view event is recorded once after the display finishes loading and once on each display or filter-view switch.
  • Ordinary row refreshes are not counted as new display views.
  • Display, field, and density usage is measured as specified in Story 12.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-TBD (Story 12 has no Jira story yet) — Story 12 Google Analytics for display and field usage; SV-10048 — Story 5 Choose what is shown. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S12-R1, S12-R6, S5-R7 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R1: “Measure display usage after successful initial loading and each display or filter-view switch.”
  • S12-R6: “Do not count ordinary row refreshes as new display views.”
  • S5-R7: “Measure display, field, and density usage as specified in Story 12.”
